claim: Videos on specific websites won't load : r/techsupport - Reddit
summary: Youtube, Vimeo, Dailymotion, LiveLeak, pornhub, spankwire, and some other major video streaming sites all work fine close to 100% of the time. Other sites like redtube, youporn, and tube8 sometimes work and sometime don't. However on sites such as xvideos, xhamster, and Twitch.tv vods (Only vods, not livestreams) videos almost never load. Sometimes I can let the video buffer for 10-20 minutes ...
